hero_headline:
The People We **Trust**
With Your Day
hero_lede: Den 1880’s preferred vendors. Every name here has worked in this building, knows the kitchen and the loading door, and hosts the way we do.
intro_body: A short list, kept short on purpose. These are the caterers, planners, florists, photographers and performers we hand our clients to — people whose work we have watched up close, in these rooms, more than once. Book any of them direct. Tell them the event is at Den 1880 and they will already know the room.
